name: usage-meter
description: Claude Code subscription usage at the bottom right: the 5-hour and weekly windows.

accentColor.title: Accent color
accentColor.description: Color of the usage bar below 75%.

position.title: Position
position.description: Where it shows: above (the band above the prompt), footer (right of the line under the prompt), hint (end of the hints under the prompt) or status (a pinned line under the prompt). hint and status show plain text, without colors.

hideCycleHint.title: Hide the mode cycle hint
hideCycleHint.description: Drop "(shift+tab to cycle)" after the permission mode, to leave room for the meter.
